name: Easy Overnight Oats

ingredients.name: to 3 teaspoons maple syrup, plus more to taste

instructions.primary_message: In a 1-quart container or medium bowl, whisk together oat milk, maple syrup, vanilla paste or extract (if using), and salt until well combined.
Add oats and chia seeds and stir to combine.
Refrigerate until oats have softened and thickened, at least 8 hours and up to 24 hours. Sweeten with additional maple syrup as needed and serve with fresh fruit, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: overnight oats, overnight oats recipe, oats overnight, how to make overnight oats

description: These spectacularly creamy overnight oats take all of five minutes to prep, and are lightly sweetened with maple syrup and vanilla.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 8 hr 5 min.

Optional or for serving: 1 teaspoon vanilla paste or extract (optional); Fruit, for serving (optional)

Notes: Your choice of dairy or dairy-free milk can be substituted for oat milk. I tested this with regular sweetened oat milk, but if you’d like to cut down on the sugar, you can use unsweetened oat milk. To make gluten-free overnight oats, use gluten-free rolled oats.

Make-ahead and storage: The recipe can easily be doubled. Overnight oats can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
author: Genevieve Yam
